summary: Master the art of project management with our comprehensive training course. Gain practical skills and knowledge to excel in technical project leadership.
lede: Technical project management covers planning and governing software, infrastructure, and systems integration initiatives. Designed for technical project managers, infrastructure managers, engineering leads, systems integration specialists, and Scrum Masters, the course supports delivery planning across technical teams. Learners practise selecting Waterfall, Agile, or Hybrid methods, structuring technical work breakdowns, estimating effort with PERT and story points, and managing deployment risks.
audienceIntro: This program is engineered for professionals who operate at the intersection of technical execution and project governance. It provides the structured methodologies required to lead complex IT, software, and infrastructure initiatives.
modules: Scoping and Technical Work Breakdown Structures
Project Recovery, EVM, and Final Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of IT operations, software development lifecycles, or engineering principles. No advanced programming or coding experience is required, but familiarity with general technical terminology will be highly beneficial.
